title: Q9
description:
Read: Deu 32:43

The line about the angels worshipping agrees with the Greek form of the song. The Hebrew text behind the NKJV of that verse does not contain it. In the song, the call stands where God avenges blood and makes atonement for his land and his people.

a) What moment is the worship of the Son being tied to?

b) The Hebrew line of the same song does not command that worship. What does the form the letter quotes put on the Son that the other form does not say?
